name: Space Sniper Maya
original_name: スペーススナイパー・マヤ
source:
Year 2XXX. A certain star is in the middle of the crisis of possible invasion. In order to protect her universe space sniper Maya got a mission to infiltrate enemy lines and assassinate the leader.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2XXX年。某颗恒星正处于可能被入侵的危机之中。为了保护她的宇宙，太空狙击手玛雅接到了渗透敌方防线并刺杀领导人的任务。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
